access.general.name: Wifi connection failures
access.general.description: Reviewers report the app fails to connect over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some song quality seems poor.

access.login_failure.name: Login and password failures
access.login_failure.description: Reviewers say the app won't let them into their account or accepts their password, alongside complaints about too many ads.

billing.charges_refund.name: Premium cost concerns
billing.charges_refund.description: Reviewers feel the app has shifted toward paid premium mainly to generate revenue for the company.

billing.premium_paywall.name: Features locked behind premium
billing.premium_paywall.description: Reviewers say basic actions like choosing songs, skipping, or replaying sections now require a premium subscription.

catalog.general.name: Missing songs and genres
catalog.general.description: Reviewers note that many songs are absent from the library and certain music genres, such as gospel, are thin.

catalog.lyrics.name: Lyrics missing or inconsistent
catalog.lyrics.description: Reviewers report lyrics sometimes fail to display or are available for some songs but not others.

catalog.recommendations.name: Weaker song recommendations
catalog.recommendations.description: Reviewers feel recommendations used to offer more songs and newer releases than they do now.

downloads.download_failure.name: Downloads get stuck
downloads.download_failure.description: Reviewers report song downloads stalling indefinitely in the background without completing.

downloads.offline_play.name: Offline playback broken
downloads.offline_play.description: Reviewers say the app does not play music correctly when offline.

other.general_dislike.name: General negative sentiment
other.general_dislike.description: Reviewers express broad dissatisfaction with the app, often citing a recent update, without specifying a particular problem.

playback.crash_freeze.name: App crashes after update
playback.crash_freeze.description: Reviewers report the app crashes or cannot open following a recent update.

playback.general.name: General playback malfunctions
playback.general.description: Reviewers report songs not playing, repeat and section-play failing, voice assistant not starting playback, and audio adjustment bugs.

playback.lag_loading.name: Stuck on loading screen
playback.lag_loading.description: Reviewers report the app hangs on the loading or logo screen and does not proceed.

playback.stops_pauses.name: Playback stops unexpectedly
playback.stops_pauses.description: Reviewers say music stops halfway through a track and does not resume where it left off, starting a different song instead.

usability.ads.name: Too many or loud ads
usability.ads.description: Reviewers complain of frequent, loud advertisements interrupting songs, especially for users without premium.

usability.playlist_library.name: Home screen layout disliked
usability.playlist_library.description: Reviewers dislike the new home screen, which shows one playlist, album, or artist at a time in a scrolling feed.

usability.shuffle_queue.name: Shuffle and skip limitations
usability.shuffle_queue.description: Reviewers complain playlists play in random order, songs cannot be chosen directly, and skips are capped, making listening frustrating.

usability.ui_layout.name: Requests for feature tweaks
usability.ui_layout.description: Reviewers praise a feature such as Blend but request enhancements like renaming Blends.
